_comment: Purpose: editable event catalogue. All details below are SAMPLE DATA; confirm before publishing. countdownDate marks the start of the calendar date, NOT the event start time. Use an explicit +05:30 offset for Odisha. ticketUrl must be a verified HTTPS ticketing platform URL. Set both startTime and endTime to ISO timestamps for timed calendar entries; otherwise calendars use an all-day reminder. Add past events to this same array; pages group them automatically by India calendar date. A null price means not yet confirmed.
